10539-46305.title: Skai > Predict > Breaking (375x812px)
10539-46305.notes: Mobile (10539-46305, 10545-47421) and tablet (10654-197572, 10710-132119) stack four blocks: a hero card, a numbered 1-15 movers list (question + chance + delta), a 'Get daily updates' email-capture card, and a 'Live from @skai.predict' timestamped signals feed. TWO of the four now have implementations. The hero is PredictHero rendering its honest no-featured-market shell. The movers list is BUILT 2026-08-05 - PredictInsightsPanel renders a real ranked MoverRow list off signedProbabilityMoveBps over the priorProbability join - and falls back to its stated-empty panel only because outcome_trades holds zero rows, which is a measurement rather than a hardcoded impossibility. THE OTHER TWO ARE NOW DECLINES, NOT BACKLOG — investigated 2026-08-05 and neither can ship honestly. The 'Get daily updates' email-capture card: `waitlist_emails` exists but it is the skai.trade LANDING waitlist synced to Customer.io, and there is no predict daily-digest sender anywhere in src or supabase/functions, so the card would take an address against a mail that will never be sent — or quietly enrol the user in an unrelated list. The 'Live from @skai.predict' signals feed: that handle does not exist. grep across src, modules/skai-bot and supabase returns zero hits for `skai.predict`, and the only official accounts the codebase knows are instagram.com/skai.trade and x.com/SkaiTrade. A feed 'live from' an account nobody owns can only be fabricated. Recorded as declines so they stop reading as unstarted work; the family stays partial because the movers list is measured-empty (outcome_trades zero-row), which is data, not code. [vverify: partial | Breaking, mobile 375. Four stacked blocks; TWO have implementations. Hero is PredictHero rendering its honest no-featured-market shell. The numbered 1-15 movers list is BUILT 2026-08-05 - PredictInsightsPanel renders MoverRow (rank, question link, current chance, signed delta) ranked by signedProbabilityMoveBps over the priorProbability join, the same rule the Breaking sort tab uses - and falls back to its stated-empty panel only because outcome_trades holds zero rows. THE OTHER TWO ARE NOW DECLINES, NOT BACKLOG, investigated 2026-08-05. (a) 'Get daily updates' email capture: waitlist_emails exists but it is the skai.trade LANDING waitlist synced to Customer.io, and there is no predict daily-digest sender anywhere in src or supabase/functions. Shipping the card would take an address against a mail that will never be sent, or silently enrol the user in an unrelated list. (b) 'Live from @skai.predict': that handle does not exist. grep across src, modules/skai-bot and supabase returns zero hits for skai.predict, and the only official accounts the codebase knows are instagram.com/skai.trade and x.com/SkaiTrade (SiteFooter). The feed would have to fabricate posts from an account nobody owns. Both are declined for the record so they stop reading as unstarted work.]

The felt ribbon and the rules panel both promise "Blackjack pays 3 to 2"; the POINTS rail used to compute `ret = h.bet * 2.5` and then FLOOR it, so a natural on a 1-point stake returned floor(2.5) = 2 - even money. The felt was authoritative (3:2 is the advertised, industry-standard rule and the rail's own header comment claims it at supabase/functions/points-game/index.ts:2336), so the RAIL was underpaying, and the fix is `ret = Math.round(ret)` at supabase/functions/points-game/index.ts:2722 - the fraction is only ever exactly 0.5, so half-up never pays less than the advertised rule and every even stake is untouched. Landed in commit 7aa07b6d8 (2026-08-04) and VERIFIED LIVE: deployed points-game v99 (deployed 2026-08-05T01:36Z, after the 22:47Z commit) contains `Math.round(ret)` and zero occurrences of `Math.floor(ret)`. All four now render the rail's real value. M6r9FEn042UWTQD1zvy6GM:9104-6283.title: Plinko Old
M6r9FEn042UWTQD1zvy6GM:9104-6283.notes: ★ 2026-08-05: the four board/panel defects recorded on 2026-08-05 are FIXED IN SOURCE against the frames; still `partial` because nothing was render-measured and the tablet/mobile tier is unbuilt. WHAT WAS FIXED. (1) PER-DIFFICULTY PALETTE. PlinkoGame.tsx now carries three ramps in PLINKO_BUCKET_RAMPS, each sampled bucket-by-bucket off its own frame: Easy (low) #90E3E7 #7DD4E7 #69C6E6 #57B8E6 #46ACE6 #349EE6 #2391E6 #1184E6 #0078E6 from 9069:6513; Medium #A1E03C #8ED639 #7ACD37 #67C334 #55BB31 #44B12F #34A72C #34A72C #1A9627 from 9095:5889; Hard (high) #E590F2 #DB85EE #D17CEB #C771E7 #BE68E3 #B45EE0 #AA55DC #A04CD9 #9744D5 from 9095:5332. Previously ONE ramp - the Easy one - was hardcoded and painted on all three, so Medium and Hard rendered the wrong colourway outright. (2) THE RAMP IS MIRRORED. Each array runs EDGE->CENTRE and getMultiplierSlotColor indexes it by distance from the centre bucket, so the row is symmetric exactly as all three frames draw it. The old getMultiplierSlotColors mapped t = index/(total-1) monotonically and colour-inverted the right half of every board; the comment asserting the frame was "NOT a symmetric center-out ramp" was itself the bug and is replaced - those nine stops were precisely the nine distinct colours of the mirrored HALF row. Colours were histogrammed rather than eyedropped once: an un-crossed grate is NOT a black disc - its interior is the ROAD colour and what makes it read is a #041f1d rim plus five #001615 bars stroked #247570, where the board filled the whole disc #001615, the BAR colour, so every lane looked like a hole in the tarmac. Next lane is #34afa7, a crossed lane is #17f9b4 mint with the bolt cut through it in road colour. The chip was INVERTED: Figma draws a road-coloured pill with a #061817 border and #889f9d text, the board drew a pale #b4c3c1 pill with near-black text. The roadblock also belongs on the NEXT lane while playing, not only on crossed ones - that is what holds the traffic still. * LADDER RE-DERIVED rather than inherited, and still exact at all three difficulties: floor(9800*C(20,k)/C(20-H,k)) at a 2% edge over 20 lanes reproduces Easy 9432-8016 (1.03x..19.60x, 19 rungs), Medium In-Play 9432-5358 (1.15x..1117.20x, 17) and Hard 9429-2075 (1.31x..15193.92x, 15) chip for chip. The full column renders: widget + bet panel + 19-lane road with its live rung ladder (1.03x..19.60x), stats/fairness strip, tabs, game-info card, community wins, more-games carousel, bets panel, about/licences/FAQ, footer. GAMEPLAY IS WIRED TO THE RAIL: clicking Play calls ChickenGame.startGame -> callEdgeFunction and the round is refused with "Chicken requires a signed-in wallet" (gameSettlementService.ts:1335) - i.e. the only blocker is that the local dev session has no wallet, not a code path gap. Nothing about the route needed fixing. ★ 2026-08-05 TAIL PASS - THE LADDER IS NOW VERIFIED AGAINST AN INDEPENDENT ORACLE, PER FRAME, AND THE FRAME COUNT WAS OVERSTATED. LADDER: all three difficulty boards were read straight off their Figma renders and compared with a ladder computed separately from ChickenGame.tsx calculateMultiplier (hypergeometric without replacement, x0.98) - not re-derived from the same source that drew them. Easy 9432-8016: 19 of 19 rungs identical (1.03 ... 19.60). Hard 9432-9285: 15 of 15 identical (1.31 ... 15193.92). Medium 9432-8667: 16 of 17 identical, and the one divergence is a rounding representation rather than a price - rung 4 is exactly 0.98 x C(20,4)/C(17,4) = 1.99500, which Figma rounds half-up to 2.00 and the client floors to 1.99; the rail freezes 19950 bps either way, so the payout is identical and the client-s label is the conservative one. Left alone deliberately: changing it would make the display overstate. Nothing in the ladder, hazard model or edge was touched. FRAME COUNT: each difficulty board is drawn TWICE at two canvas sizes - 621-tall (9431-3268 Easy 3337x621, 9428-6660 Medium 3025x621, 9429-2075 Hard 2709x621) and 247-tall (9432-8016 / 9432-8667 / 9432-9285) - so six rows describe three boards, not six unbuilt screens. ONE FRAME DEFECT REPORTED, NOT BUILT: the mobile in-play board 9429-2661 prints 1.15x / 1.37x / 1.64x / 1.64x, duplicating rung 3 where rung 4 is 1.995x; the client is handed the round-s frozen ladderBps by the server and prints that, so it cannot reach a player. Per-frame verdicts now live in vverify.chicken.tsv, including the ten hazard/character art frames, all of which are shipped under modules/skai-gaming/src/assets/games/chicken/ and imported by ChickenRoad.tsx. ★★★ 2026-08-05: 3 of the 4 remaining partial frames close. 9363-1963 (desktop page) and 9363-2936 (mobile page) were each held for a verification gap rather than a build gap ('not text-node diffed against this frame', 'Not measured at 375 this pass'); both are now measured in a real browser on /play/chicken. At 1440: all seven page regions present, 0px horizontal overflow, forbidden-string sweep clean, and the Easy ladder renders all 19 rungs 1.03 ... 19.60 read off the live DOM, identical to the oracle-verified values. At 375: 0px overflow, all regions present, and exactly ONE Play control - i.e. the responsive page does NOT paint a second board under the first, which is the specific defect Hi-Lo had at this breakpoint. 9428-8535 (in-play) closes because the in-play chips are not the client's own arithmetic - the server hands the round its FROZEN ladderBps and the client renders that, so they cannot drift from what the round will pay. STILL PARTIAL for ONE frame: 9429-2661, and that is a FRAME DEFECT reported rather than built - its four visible chips read 1.15x, 1.37x, 1.64x, 1.64x, the Medium ladder with rung 4 duplicated where the real ladder is 1.15 / 1.37 / 1.64 / 1.995 / 2.46. Nothing reproduces it and no player can see it; the frame should be corrected upstream. The ladder, hazard model and edge are settled and frame-exact and were NOT touched.
